shape_hint: Flat rectangular (nearly square) plate with a round bolt hole in the middle and rounded or clipped corners; in side view it is a wedge: one face is flat and the other slopes at 8 percent across the width so the thickness is lowest at one edge and highest at the opposite edge.

role_map.a: nominal side length a of the rectangular washer
role_map.b: nominal side length b of the washer, the side along which the 8% slope runs (inferred from the h-e check); b may differ from a
role_map.h: nominal height (thickness) h of the wedge-shaped washer

notes: DIN 434 = square taper washer for U (channel) sections, 8% taper. DIN 435 (I-sections, 14% taper) is not published (only one reliable table). Missing rows M12 and M16 are on purpose: sources disagree on d1 (13.5/17.5 vs 14/18). The values a and b listed here are nominal sizes; M12/M16/M20/M22 have b larger than a (e.g. M12: 26 x 30). Slope check (see checks) was done with the dimension e which is not published. Weights, tolerance limits not published. KS / ASTM F436 correspondence not verified.
